# Bagseven

Avalanche C-Chain paid access and agent spending. Current live configuration targets public Fuji chain 43113. Mainnet 43114 is supported by network helpers but is not a verified launch here. Payment token is explicitly configured with AVALANCHE_USDC and must have six decimals.

Email proves inbox control. Wallet ownership uses a signed, expiring account-bound message. Neither proves unique humanity. Browser uses console BFF APIs; service keys remain server-side.

GrantStore: mint/get/findLive/consume/cancelRenewal/hold/commit/release. AvalancheGrantStore uses private PostgreSQL metadata for discovery and reads balances from BagEntitlementRegistry. Expired records remain stored but are excluded from live access. Subjects are HMAC hashes on-chain; preserve ENTITLEMENT_SUBJECT_SECRET across restarts.

Prepaid usage needs a living authorized grant and enough credits. New agent payments require an active agent, remaining mandate capacity, and a living grant. Credit units and stablecoin amounts differ.

Recurring billing uses fixed-price BagSubscriptionPlan, explicit payer allowance/subscribe/cancel, and durable collection/fulfillment journals. Cancellation preserves paid time. Unknown transaction outcomes require reconciliation of the same signed bytes.

Provider-funded gas is mandatory in production. Authorized encrypted delegated keys pay AVAX under server-enforced fee budgets. Do not call these EOA restrictions on-chain smart-account limits. No platform-wallet fallback.

SDK: @bagseven/sdk; browser wallet helpers connectAvalancheWallet/payStablecoinOnAvalanche/subscribeOnAvalanche/cancelAvalancheSubscription. MCP: HTTPS /mcp with email-code plus wallet consent, OAuth PKCE, scoped access and rotating refresh tokens. HTTP MCP is stateless. OAuth codes/tokens, email-consent challenges and rate limits persist in PostgreSQL with atomic single-use exchanges.

Code: services/daemon/src/grants.ts, billing.ts, subscriptions.ts, avalanche-payment.ts; packages/entitlements/src/avalanche-store.ts; packages/contracts/src/BagEntitlementRegistry.sol; scripts/bagseven-mcp.ts and mcp-account-auth.ts.

Isolated x402: separately approved encrypted payment signer; mandate-enforced funding; durable jobs; EIP-3009 nonce/transfer reconciliation; no refund while a payment signature can settle. Use bagseven_x402_payment for status. Apply all migrations through 0024 and preserve the separate daemon-only X402_PAYMENT_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
Builder: /app/builder customizes one complete customer embed (cmp_customer): plans, wallets, checkout, prepaid credits and renewals. Drafts and explicit published snapshots persist in PostgreSQL with provider scope and revision checks; apply all migrations through 0024. Hosted iframe credentials use an exact-origin parent-window postMessage handshake, never new token-bearing URLs. React and legacy standalone components remain supported.

Public Fuji activation: pnpm fuji:registry deploy (local keystore approval), pnpm fuji:prepare, pnpm fuji:activate --apply. A separate public-chain database excludes Anvil fixtures. Existing local product ports remain unchanged; hosting is a separate step. Provider gas and customer financial approvals must be newly signed.

Customer billing: /app/customers lists provider-scoped paid customers; unpaid checkout drafts are excluded from customer and invoice lists. /app/invoices lists issued documents and own purchases. Migration 0022 snapshots invoice terms atomically with checkout/renewal journals; verified payments produce receipts, separately from entitlement fulfillment. Documents are private to issuer, billed holder or authenticated billing email, and printable. Paid receipts are automatically emailed through a durable outbox with narrowly scoped 30-day document links. They do not assess taxes. Historical unrecorded token/payment times remain unknown.

Account onboarding: email code, wallet connection and ownership signature. Saved wallet bindings persist after disconnect. Reconnect never implicitly replaces an account wallet. Explicit replacement requires a fresh inbox proof and new wallet signature; server preflight and submission both enforce it. Public-Fuji local mode uses DEV_MODE=false and returns no development auth codes or links. Preview hints require explicit DEV_MODE=true outside production.

Wallet approval coordination: shared withWalletOperation blocks competing actions and uses same-origin Web Locks when available. No automatic retries or timer-based release of live approvals. A wallet -32002 requires manual review/dismissal in the wallet; acknowledging the application reminder sends nothing.

Documentation: /docs/introduction, /docs/quickstart, /docs/guides/authentication, /docs/guides/builder, /docs/guides/subscriptions, /docs/guides/customers-invoices, /docs/guides/provider-gas, /docs/guides/x402, /docs/guides/mcp, /docs/troubleshooting. Repository details: README.md, docs/PRODUCT.md, docs/DEVELOPERS.md, docs/HOSTING.md, docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/design.md.

Customer billing v2 (migration 0023): trusted SaaS backend identifies holder plus verified email; customer tokens bind billing contact. SDK supports host EIP-1193 provider/account and explicit authorized account selection, rejects self-payment, displays deadlines and recent paid invoices, and preserves checkout/payment-hash recovery across reload. Default payment window is 30 minutes; expire durably, reconcile in-window payments, and purge only unpaid unreferenced drafts after 30 days. Paid receipts queue atomically for customer email with provider idempotency and fenced leases; uncertain delivery beyond 23h requires reconciliation. Shared receipt links are document-specific, signed and valid 30 days. Never expose raw billing email on-chain or consume credits merely from a billing-portal test button.

Provider API keys (migration 0024): verified provider creates named expiring bgs_sk_/bgs_pk_ keys. Secrets appear only on creation and persist only as hashes; public values are copyable. Revoke in Developers; derived customer tokens also fail on subsequent requests. Provider resource boundaries apply across equal holder IDs. Browser keys cannot read private customer access or invoices. Internal daemon credentials never go to browsers. Builder and hosted designs use provider public keys. Rotate shared API secrets exposed by older Developers endpoints without changing wallet/encryption/entitlement-subject secrets.

MCP connection continuity: configured CONSOLE_URL reuses the verified dashboard session through explicit Authorize and return to ChatGPT consent. Single-use PostgreSQL request/proof bridge binds issuer, original OAuth query and initiating browser; callback rechecks linked wallet. S256 PKCE, callback path, resource and scope are validated. No new OTP/signature for a valid verified session. A changed temporary tunnel hostname requires reconnecting the single current Bagseven app; discovery alone never proves native ChatGPT calls.
